immutable_rules.text: Each completed cycle pays exactly +$1 when inhale is longer, -$1 when exhale is longer, and $0 when durations are equal. Ren has personally tested only the +$1 direction.
Ren opens with $43.17. Chapter One explicitly shows eight $1 deposits, so $51.17 is only a minimum supported ending balance; the exact ending balance is unknown.
$600 per hour, $14,400 per day, and $5,256,000 per year are projections at ten cycles per minute, not money already earned.

Money-Breathing Art is acquired, but no progression milestone, passive effect, physical enhancement, secret-setting knowledge, ancestry, special territory, or higher per-cycle rate is currently unlocked.
Ren remains a broke delivery driver in a failing Hyundai with low gas, debt, bills, and no established apartment, house, business, sect, or supernatural ally.
The seed establishes that the money is legally recognized, but Ren has not verified taxes, documentation, bank treatment, or the source of the Exchange.
